_comment: nova_relay config. Fill team_domain + aud from the Cloudflare Access application, then restart net.digitalnoise.nova-relay. Until aud is set, ONLY loopback callers with X-Relay-Local-Secret are accepted — every Cloudflare-borne request is refused, so publishing the hostname early fails closed.

devices._comment: map Access service-token common_name (or SSO email) -> short friendly device label used in audit rows
